name: Global activity (PMI)
summary: J.P.Morgan global composite PMI 53.2 in October, down from 54.3 but above the 51 Watch line; no newer data by 15 Nov
state: The J.P.Morgan Global Composite PMI fell to 53.2 in October from 54.3 in September (S&P Global, 5 Nov; Placera, 4 Nov). S&P Global said growth slowed but remained elevated amid heightened economic uncertainty, consistent with annualised global GDP growth of about 2.9%. The reading remains well above the 51 Watch line; November flash PMIs are due later in the month.
for_you: Global business activity is still expanding, so there is no broad global slowdown for now. Firms tied to trade and energy-intensive sectors are the most exposed if growth slows further.
